text:
anya: Kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding — focusing on AWS/GCP/Azure initial setup, legal copy, packaging assets, and SI integration notes. Who can own what?

ravi: I'll take SI partner onboarding checklist (SI integration guide + sample terraform). Need contact for SI onboarding and an SSH key policy.

emily-marketing: Creative owner here — will produce icons, hero, and short/long descriptions. Any character limits? Portal typically wants 200/1000 for short/long.

olga-partnerops: I'll handle publisher accounts and entitlements. Requesting publisher role list and KMS key templates. Also verify private offer flow for Azure.

sarah-legal: I'll review the offer text and add KMS/retention clauses. If we promise data residency for private deployments, we need an addendum.

ravi: For SI guide, proposing a minimal terraform snippet and a sample webhook verification. Example snippet: {"resource":"google_compute_instance","name":"rdw-agent"} — will expand in docs.

anya: Action list: (1) ravi: SI guide + terraform snippet (2) olga: create staging publisher + entitlements (3) emily: assets + localized strings (4) sarah-legal: offer/legal blurb. Target: staging dry-run next Tue.

olga-partnerops: cloud-bot can create staging credentials?

cloud-bot: created publisher-staging-1819 and entitlement-staging-1819, credentials pushed to #vault :white_check_mark:

emily-marketing: I'll aim to upload EN/FR/ES copy and assets by Monday EOD. Need clarification on hero text: short line only or include tagline? Prefer short line + one-liner.

sarah-legal: Drafted the privacy/KMS paragraph and uploaded to Drive: https://go.example.com/mkt-eula-draft. Please comment by EOD Monday.

ravi: SI note — hardware partnerships: if listing includes partner GPU SKUs, need SKU mapping table and hardware minimums. Tagging @olga to coordinate.

olga-partnerops: Noted. We'll add a hardware compatibility table to the publisher metadata and an install checklist for partners.

anya: Schedule: Monday EOD assets + legal drafts, Tuesday 09:30 PT dry-run (staging publish + entitlement activation + SI deploy smoke test), Tuesday 16:00 PT quick retro. Anyone blocked?

emily-marketing: No blockers.

ravi: Will need sample tenant for SI smoke test — olga can share or cloud-bot create.

cloud-bot: temp-tenant created: tenant-staging-1819, creds to #vault.

olga-partnerops: Sharing tenant and a short runbook in the onboarding docs. Will also attach the ARM/TF templates.

sarah-legal: If we add hardware SKU pricing, finance will need the metering dimensions. Recommend per-1k tokens + instance-hour for dedicated appliances.

anya: Good call. Finance prefer per-1k + instance-hour for dedicated. Put both in billing metadata sample.

ravi: I'll add a sample billing metadata JSON to the SI guide and link it here.

anya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Tue 09:30 PT. Close thread unless blockers appear. :rocket:
